events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The ongoing conflict in Iran continues to escalate, with potential for further geopolitical instability in the Middle East. This could lead to increased volatility in oil prices and global markets. The US and its allies are considering further action, which could exacerbate the situation.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The conflict in Iran has the potential to disrupt global oil supplies, leading to increased prices and volatility. This could have a ripple effect on global markets, making the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust a potential buy. On the other hand, the iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF could be shorted as the conflict may lead to decreased demand for oil.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the situation closely and adjust as needed

events.exitStrategy: Exit when the conflict shows signs of de-escalation or when oil prices stabilize
